description: Fleet Size Requirements for Each GSE Type at Each Airport is a data set deposited in DOE Pacific Northwest National Laboratory (PNNL) Repository by its authors Yi He, Kenneth Kelly (National Laboratory of the Rockies). This dataset contains the required number of vehicles for each GSE type at each airport under six charging scenarios: (1) charging when the battery state of charge is insufficient for the next service using 40-kW chargers (S1); (2) charging when the battery state of charge is insufficient for the next service using 20-kW chargers (S2) ... Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29).
